recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future GTIN registry corrections should be made in THO/NamingSystem-gtin unless Vocabulary/TSMG reopens the FHIR-37853 policy and explicitly asks core to duplicate the row.
issue_request: FHIR-17940 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary issue asking to add GTIN to terminologies-systems.html, citing the GS1 GTIN URL https://www.gs1.org/gtin and resolving the change as pre-applied.
initial_application: Commit bc2fbf0da2bedef715d54d01c4bdf33e613bac59 added a GTIN row to source/terminologies-systems.html with https://www.gs1.org/gtin, OID 1.3.160, and a note that GTINs may be used in Coding and Identifier. That application aligned with FHIR-13499, which selected the GS1 GTIN URL.
additional_context: Current terminologies-systems.html remains in the active build through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, but FHIR-37853 later established HL7 Terminology (THO) as the source of truth for external code and identifier system information. Commit 736ccce2005fd2c8c2d20dfe8df948e8c9d586d8 applied that policy and removed external rows without a Using X with FHIR page, including GTIN. The current core page points readers to THO, and hl7.terminology 7.1.0 includes NamingSystem/gtin with preferred URI https://www.gs1.org/gtin and OID 1.3.160.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding GTIN to core terminologies-systems.html would conflict with the later THO source-of-truth decision and duplicate authoritative THO registry content.
